stem: In which sentence from the story “Saturday Surprise” does the author’s use of language best convey a satisfied mood?

options.label: A
options.text: Each Saturday as the sun was rising, he urged his dad to take him to the neighborhood basketball court. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: He looked over his shoulder to see a tall player effortlessly shoot a basket. (paragraph 2)

options.label: C
options.text: Honoring Jamie’s privacy, Logan turned his attention back to his own layups. (paragraph 7)

options.label: D
options.text: When the game was over, a winded but happy Logan joined his dad on the sidelines. (paragraph 11)
